shortDescription: Manages port forwarding rules on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the I(vm) is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the I(vm) is related to.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Public IP address the rule is assigned to.

options.name: network
options.description: Name of the network. Required when forwarding ports in a VPC.

options.name: open_firewall
options.description: Whether the firewall rule for public port should be created, while creating the new rule. Not supported when forwarding ports in a VPC. Use M(ngine_io.cloudstack.firewall) for managing firewall rules.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: private_end_port
options.description: End private port for this rule. If not specified equal I(private_port).

options.name: private_port
options.description: Start private port for this rule.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the I(vm) is located in.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol of the port forwarding rule.

options.name: public_end_port
options.description: End public port for this rule. If not specified equal I(public_port).

options.name: public_port
options.description: Start public port for this rule.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the port forwarding rule.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). To delete all tags, set a empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vm
options.description: Name of virtual machine which we make the port forwarding rule for. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: vm_guest_ip
options.description: VM guest NIC IP address for the port forwarding rule.

options.name: vpc
options.description: Name of the VPC.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the virtual machine is in.
